asset_heavy.reason: Operates hundreds of large vehicle storage yards worldwide, requiring ongoing land purchases and yard investment to grow.

big_ticket.reason: Fees per vehicle sale are modest and frequent; sellers (insurers) consign many vehicles, though a vehicle purchase is sizable for individual buyers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Salvage volumes come from insurance claims and accidents, which continue in downturns; used-car demand is also resilient.

large_customers.reason: Main sellers are large insurance companies, fleet and rental companies; buyers include dealers and dismantlers.

notes: Buyer mix includes some individuals, but dealers, dismantlers and exporters are the larger buyer base; sellers are mainly insurers.

offers_products.reason: Copart mainly earns fees from auctions of vehicles it typically consigns rather than manufactures or owns; some purchased vehicles are sold.

offers_services.reason: Online auction marketplace services: vehicle towing, storage, remarketing and sale for insurers and other sellers.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the online auction platform, yard network and logistics assets rather than staff time and skill.

recurring_revenue.reason: Insurers and repeat buyers consign and purchase continually under ongoing contracts, generating repeat auction fees and storage revenue.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Public individuals can register and bid on used and salvage cars, motorcycles and trucks.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurers, dealers, dismantlers, rebuilders and exporters are main sellers and buyers on the auction platform.
